synos.cn: 不吸引人注意的；没有魅力的；不美丽的

trans.cn: không biết, không biết, không biết
trans.cn_source: 不知道的，未察觉到的，未意识到的

trans.cn: một cách bất ngờ, vô tình
trans.cn_source: 意外地，不知不觉地

sentences.c: He was blithely unaware of the trouble he'd caused.
sentences.cn: 他漫不经心，丝毫没有察觉他惹的麻烦。

sentences.c: She was sublimely unaware of the trouble she had caused.
sentences.cn: 她压根儿没察觉自己闹出了乱子。

sentences.c: She was unaware that I could see her.
sentences.cn: 她没想到我能看见她。

synos.cn: 不知道的，无意的；未察觉到的

trans.cn: không thể chịu nổi ; không thể chịu nổi
trans.cn_source: 不堪忍受地；无法容忍地

sentences.c: By the evening it had become unbearably hot.
sentences.cn: 到了晚上天气已热得无法忍受。

sentences.c: In other places, like Egypt, it is unbearably hot.
sentences.cn: 另一些地方，像在埃及，天气仍然还是难以忍受地酷热。

sentences.c: The hiatus between new episodes is never too unbearably long!
sentences.cn: 两部分之间的间隔不会太久！

trans.cn: khách quan, không thiên vị
trans.cn_source: 公正的，无偏见的

sentences.c: There is no clear and unbiased information available for consumers.
sentences.cn: 没有清楚公正的信息提供给消费者。

sentences.c: For one thing, they're reliable insofar as they're based on unbiased samples.
sentences.cn: 首先，如若它们基于无偏见的样本，那么它们就很可靠。

sentences.c: We want an estimate of the proportion of oil which the blindfold, mill-turning, unbiased critic can squeeze out of you.
sentences.cn: 我们要的是估计一下，蒙着眼睛、转动着磨盘、不偏不倚的批评家能从你身上榨出多少油水。

phrases.cn: 不偏估计，公正（无偏）评价

trans.cn: bí ẩn; kỳ quái; đáng sợ
trans.cn_source: 神秘的；离奇的；可怕的

sentences.c: She bears an uncanny resemblance to Dido.
sentences.cn: 她跟迪多长得离奇的相似。

sentences.c: I had an uncanny feeling I was being watched.
sentences.cn: 我有种被人监视的奇怪感觉。

sentences.c: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
sentences.cn: 托尼被她不寻常的熟悉面孔弄得心烦意乱。

trans.cn: 犹豫的，无把握的；无法确知的，不确定的；多变的，难预料的；信心不足的；（脚步）蹒跚的，踉跄的

sentences.c: The economic climate remains uncertain.
sentences.cn: 经济气候依然是不确定。

sentences.c: Our future looks uncertain.
sentences.cn: 我们似乎前途渺茫。

sentences.c: Her future is uncertain.
sentences.cn: 她前途未卜。

synos.cn: 无常的；含糊的；靠不住的；迟疑不决的

trans.cn: Không chắc chắn; không chắc chắn ; ngập ngừng
trans.cn_source: 不确定地；没把握地；犹豫地

sentences.c: They smiled uncertainly at one another.
sentences.cn: 他们犹豫地相视而笑。

sentences.c: He entered the hallway and stood uncertainly.
sentences.cn: 他走进门厅，站在那儿不知道做什么好。

sentences.c: "Hello," he said uncertainly.
sentences.cn: “你好，”他迟疑地说。

synos.cn: 不确定地；没把握地；犹豫地

trans.cn: 未知的；图上未标明的

sentences.c: We are entering into uncharted territory now, in terms of the amount of carbon dioxide.
sentences.cn: 在二氧化碳的数量方面，我们现在正在进入一个未知的领域。

sentences.c: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent.
sentences.cn: 在强大而多样的动机驱使下，这次运动从荒野中建立起一个国家，并在本质上塑造了一个未知大陆的性格和命运。

sentences.c: The ship hit an uncharted rock.
sentences.cn: 船撞在海图上未标示的岩石上。

trans.cn: 不纯洁的；行为不检的

sentences.c: Hospital workers in at least one case deserted their workplace in panic, thus halting the administering of potentially unclean disease spreading injections, but Ebola has not disappeared.
sentences.cn: 至少有一个病例中，医院工作人员在恐慌中离开了工作场所，从而阻止了可能传播不洁疾病的注射，但埃博拉病毒并没有消失。

sentences.c: They felt as though they had done something discreditable and unclean.
sentences.cn: 他们感到仿佛自己做了丢脸的道德败坏的事。

sentences.c: They started to think of sharing cups or plates as unclean and even impolite.
sentences.cn: 他们开始认为共享杯子或盘子是不干净的，甚至是不礼貌的。

trans.cn: 不清楚的；不易了解的

sentences.c: Your diagrams are unclear.
sentences.cn: 你的图表不清楚。

sentences.c: His motives are unclear.
sentences.cn: 他的用意不明。

sentences.c: He is still unclear about his own future.
sentences.cn: 他对自己的未来仍不清楚。

trans.cn: （尤指因头部受伤）昏迷的，不省人事的；（想法或感情）无意识的，潜意识的；没意识到某事物；（行为）下意识的，无意中做出的
Vô thức (hoạt động tinh thần vô thức) (vô thức)
trans.cn_source: 无意识（不察觉的心理活动）（the unconscious）

sentences.c: The young man flopped back, unconscious.
sentences.cn: 那年轻人仰面倒下，不省人事。

sentences.c: He had drunk himself unconscious on vodka.
sentences.cn: 他喝伏特加酒喝得不省人事。

sentences.c: She was knocked unconscious.
sentences.cn: 她被打昏了。

synos.cn: [心理]无意识的；失去知觉的；[医]不省人事的；未发觉的

trans.cn: 不知不觉；无意识地

sentences.c: Consciously or unconsciously, you made a choice.
sentences.cn: 不管是有意还是无意，你已作出了选择。

sentences.c: Perhaps, unconsciously, I've done something to offend her.
sentences.cn: 我也许无意中做了什么得罪她的事。

sentences.c: Many women whose fathers left home unconsciously expect to be betrayed by their own mates.
sentences.cn: 许多父亲弃家出走的妇女会在无意中料想她们会被自己的配偶所背叛。

trans.cn: không thể kiểm soát được; không thể quản lý được; không thể quản lý được
trans.cn_source: 无法控制的；无法管束的；难以驾驭的

sentences.c: Mark was withdrawn and uncontrollable.
sentences.cn: 马克性格孤僻，无法管束。

sentences.c: It had been a time of almost uncontrollable excitement.
sentences.cn: 那曾是个激动时刻，那激动几乎无法控制。

sentences.c: If political problems are not resolved, the situation may become uncontrollable.
sentences.cn: 如果政治问题得不到解决，局势可能变得无法控制。

synos.cn: 无法控制的；无法管束的；难以驾驭的

trans.cn: 非常规的，不依惯例的；（人、态度、行为）不遵循传统的，标新立异的

sentences.c: The vaccine had been produced by an unconventional technique.
sentences.cn: 这种疫苗是用非常规的技术生产出来的。

sentences.c: Despite his unconventional methods, he has inspired students more than anyone else.
sentences.cn: 虽然用的是非常规的方法，他却比其他人更多地启发了学生。

sentences.c: You're deliberately unconventional. Even your choice of clothes is a statement of your nonconformity.
sentences.cn: 你故意有悖传统，甚至连着装都在表明你与众不同。

synos.cn: 非常规的；非传统的；不依惯例的

trans.cn: 粗野的；没把握的；不冷静沉着的；土里土气的

sentences.c: People are very laid-back about spotting celebrities here - nobody wants to look uncool by pointing and shouting.
sentences.cn: 在这里见到明星人们都表现得很放松-没有人指指点点或大声喊叫，这样看起来不酷。

sentences.c: This may come as a relief for Canadians, who are sometimes viewed as chronically uncool.
sentences.cn: 这也许对于加拿大人来说是个宽慰，因为在某些人看来，加拿大人一直都不酷。

sentences.c: But where I'm from, this is how everyone wears their jeans - if you wear them pulled up high, people think you're really uncool.
sentences.cn: 但在我住的地方，每个人都是这么穿的——如果你把裤腰提高了，人家会觉得你衰。

synos.cn: 粗野的；没把握的；不冷静沉着的；土里土气的

trans.cn: 对……提供的资金不足
đánh giá thấp; đánh giá thấp
trans.cn_source: 低估；看轻

sentences.c: We women have a lot of good business skills, although we tend to underrate ourselves.
sentences.cn: 我们女性有许多好的商业技能，只是我们往往低估自己。

sentences.c: I fear that I underrate the difficulty of the task.
sentences.cn: 我担心我低估了这项任务的困难。

sentences.c: But their official titles both overrate and underrate their authority.
sentences.cn: 但是他们官方的头衔或多或少地估计了他们的权力。

trans.cn: 低估……的价值；看轻，轻视
低于实际价值的价格

sentences.c: We must never undervalue freedom.
sentences.cn: 我们决不可低估自由的价值。

sentences.c: But rich countries undervalue women as well.
sentences.cn: 但在富裕国家中也同样低估女性的价值。

sentences.c: I think people sort of undervalue emotional life anyway.
sentences.cn: 我认为人们低估了情感生活。

trans.cn: 不受欢迎的，不良的，不想要的
不良分子，不受欢迎的人

sentences.c: While this sounds undesirable, it can be quite good, says Polman.
sentences.cn: 波尔曼说道，虽然这听起来不可取，但可能相当不错。

sentences.c: Instead of normalising the undesirable behaviour, the message needs to marginalise it.
sentences.cn: 与其将不良行为正常化，还不如利用信息将其边缘化。

sentences.c: It would be highly undesirable to increase class sizes further.
sentences.cn: 再增加班级人数，是大家都极不愿意的。

synos.cn: 不良的；不受欢迎的；不合需要的
不良分子；不受欢迎的人

trans.cn: 未开发的；不发达的；未充分发育的

sentences.c: The big losers will be the undeveloped countries, especially in sub-Saharan Africa.
sentences.cn: 最大的损失者将为不发达国家，特别是撒哈拉以南的非洲国家。

sentences.c: There are many people whose cultures are undeveloped, but the languages they speak are by no means primitive.
sentences.cn: 有许多人他们的文化不发达，但他们说的语言绝不是原始的。

sentences.c: The reason often given for the low regard in which smell is held is that, in comparison with its importance among animals, the human sense of smell is feeble and undeveloped.
sentences.cn: 人们通常不重视嗅觉的原因是，虽然嗅觉对于动物很重要，但人类的嗅觉是薄弱而不发达的。

synos.cn: 未开发的；不发达的；[生物]未充分发育的

trans.cn: chắc chắn; nhất định
trans.cn_source: 无疑的；确实的

sentences.c: The event was an undoubted success.
sentences.cn: 这次活动是一个无可置疑的成功。

sentences.c: His sincerity is undoubted.
sentences.cn: 他的诚意是无容置疑的。

sentences.c: While there's an undoubted genetic basis to individual differences, it is wrong to think that socially defined groups can be genetically accounted for.
sentences.cn: 毫无疑问，个体差异有遗传基础，但认为社会定义的群体可以通过遗传解释却是错误的。

trans.cn: 不适当的，过分的；未到期的

sentences.c: They are taking undue advantage of the situation.
sentences.cn: 他们过分利用了这种情势。

sentences.c: The work should be carried out without undue delay.
sentences.cn: 进行这项工作不得有不当的延误。

sentences.c: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
sentences.cn: 虽然法律新闻报道的质量良莠不齐，但在很多新闻记者中，存在过度依赖律师给他们提供诠释的现象。

phrases.cn: n. 不正当影响；[律]不正当压力
不当延误；不应有的延误

synos.cn: 过度的，过分的；不适当的；[金融]未到期的

trans.cn: 不经济的；浪费的

sentences.c: It would be uneconomic to try and repair it.
sentences.cn: 要修理它不划算。

sentences.c: And it reduces supply as capacity becomes uneconomic.
sentences.cn: 随着产能变得不经济，它会减少供应。

sentences.c: They lost money because of an uneconomic production process.
sentences.cn: 他们采用不经济的生产程序导致亏本。

trans.cn: Thất nghiệp, thất nghiệp; (thứ) nhàn rỗi, không được sử dụng
trans.cn_source: 未被雇用的，失业的；（物）闲置的，未用的

trans.cn: người thất nghiệp
trans.cn_source: 失业者（the unemployed）

sentences.c: How long have you been unemployed?
sentences.cn: 你失业多久了？

sentences.c: Times are hard for the unemployed.
sentences.cn: 对失业者来说，时世艰难。

sentences.c: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group.
sentences.cn: 失业者并不都是同一类人。

trans.cn: Không bằng phẳng, không đồng đều; không đều, không đồng đều; không ổn định về chất lượng; không đồng đều, không cân đối; sức mạnh chênh lệch, một chiều; không đồng đều (về kích thước hoặc chiều dài); không đều, không đều, không song song; (số) lẻ
trans.cn_source: 不平滑的，不平坦的；不规则的，不均匀的；质量不稳定的；不平等的，不平衡的；实力悬殊的，一边倒的；（大小或长度）不相等的；不平整的，不平直的，不平行的；（数）奇数的

sentences.c: He staggered on the uneven surface.
sentences.cn: 他摇摇晃晃地走在高低不平的表面上。

sentences.c: The floor felt uneven under his feet.
sentences.cn: 他觉得脚下的地板高低不平。

sentences.c: He could hear that her breathing was uneven.
sentences.cn: 他能听到她的呼吸不均匀。

synos.cn: 不均匀的；不平坦的；[数]奇数的

trans.cn: không công bằng, bất công
trans.cn_source: 不公平的，不公正的

sentences.c: Life seems so unfair sometimes.
sentences.cn: 人生有时似乎非常不公平。

sentences.c: It would be monstrously unfair.
sentences.cn: 那将太不公平了。

sentences.c: The punishment was harsh and unfair.
sentences.cn: 处罚很重而且不公平。

trans.cn: 不公平，不公正；不正当

sentences.c: We tried to meet both children's needs without the appearance of favouritism or unfairness.
sentences.cn: 我们试图在没有偏爱或不公平的表象下满足两个孩子的需要。

sentences.c: Not the pain of this but its unfairness was what dazed Peter.
sentences.cn: 使彼得晕头转向的不是痛苦，而是不公平。

sentences.c: No one ever gets over the first unfairness; no one except Peter.
sentences.cn: 没有人能克服最初的不公平；除了彼得以外。

trans.cn: Không quen; không phổ biến; thiếu kinh nghiệm
trans.cn_source: 不熟悉的；不常见的；没有经验的

sentences.c: My horse shied at the unfamiliar noise.
sentences.cn: 这陌生的声音把我的马惊了。

sentences.c: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
sentences.cn: 她在陌生的环境中感到局促不安。

sentences.c: Please highlight any terms that are unfamiliar to you.
sentences.cn: 请把你们不熟悉的用语都标示出来。

synos.cn: 不熟悉的；不常见的；没有经验的

trans.cn: 过时的；不时髦的

sentences.c: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
sentences.cn: 现如今，这种乌托邦空想已经过时了，我们对所面临的威胁有了更深刻的认识，从彗星撞击到流行感冒，再到气候变化。

sentences.c: Wearing fur has become unfashionable.
sentences.cn: 穿裘皮服装已经变得不流行了。

sentences.c: His views may be unfashionable but he deserves a hearing.
sentences.cn: 他的观点可能不合潮流，但他应该有机会解释。

trans.cn: 不宜的；令人不快的；不顺利的

sentences.c: In only one of these last eleven years was the weather unfavorable for growing citrus crops.
sentences.cn: 在过去的11年里，只有一年的天气不利于柑橘作物的生长。

sentences.c: In contrast, unfavorable conditions that occur unpredictably pose considerable problems for organisms.
sentences.cn: 相反，不可预测的不利条件会给生物体带来相当大的隐患。

sentences.c: Unfavorable conditions that are relatively predictable probably pose a simpler problem for organisms than do unpredictable conditions.
sentences.cn: 对生物体来说，相对可预测的不利条件可能比不可预测的条件造成更简单的问题。

synos.cn: 不宜的；令人不快的；不顺利的

trans.cn: 不利的；不适宜的；反对的

sentences.c: The conditions were unfavourable for agriculture.
sentences.cn: 这些条件不利于农业。

sentences.c: The decision to delay the launch stems from unfavourable weather conditions.
sentences.cn: 推迟发射的决定源于不利的天气情况。

sentences.c: The whole international economic situation is very unfavourable for the countries in the south.
sentences.cn: 整个国际经济形势非常不利于南部国家。

synos.cn: 不利的；不适宜的；反对的

trans.cn: 不可行的，难实现的

sentences.c: The weather made it unfeasible to be outdoors.
sentences.cn: 天气使人出不了门。

sentences.c: Opening up new farmland was a possibility, but most of what was suitable had already been exploited and further reclamation was technically unfeasible.
sentences.cn: 开辟新农田是可能的，但大部分适宜的土地已经开发，进一步开垦在技术上是不可行的。

sentences.c: Though possible in theory, the cost and effort of doing so makes this unfeasible in practice.
sentences.cn: 虽然这个方法理论上可行，但是其成本和代价使其在实际操作中难以实施。

trans.cn: 目光分散的；不调焦的；（视觉）模糊的；目的不明确的

sentences.c: But for now, she is in the grip of a blind, unfocused anger.
sentences.cn: 但是现在，她正被一股盲目的无目标的怒气控制着。

sentences.c: The research is too unfocused to have any significant impact.
sentences.cn: 这一次的研究太零散，难以发挥重大的作用。

sentences.c: Her eyes were unfocused, as if she were staring inside at her memories of the day.
sentences.cn: 她目光茫然，仿佛望向她对那天的回忆的深处。

trans.cn: 漫无目标的，不集中于一点的；不聚成焦点的，目光茫然的

sentences.c: The doctor fussed around her, doing all he could, even though there was no longer someone watching him with a crazy unfocussed eye.
sentences.cn: 大夫在她的周围尽他所能，瞎忙一气，尽管不再有什么人用反常的游移不定的目光注视着他。

sentences.c: If you also leave out the event name, then every event handler in the specified group is removed. So, to turn off all event handling specified in the Unfocussed group.
sentences.cn: 如果您还遗漏了事件名称，那么在指定组中的每个事件处理器也会被删除。

sentences.c: If you leave off the filename pattern, then every handler for the specified event type is removed. You could remove all the FocusLost handlers in the Unfocussed group like so.
sentences.cn: 如果您离开文件名模式，那么指定事件类型的各个处理器都会被删除。

trans.cn: 不快乐的；不幸福的；不适当的

sentences.c: I hate to see you unhappy.
sentences.cn: 我不愿见你不高兴。

sentences.c: Ferguson was unhappy and it showed.
sentences.cn: 弗格森不高兴，而且表现了出来。

sentences.c: He was a shy, sometimes unhappy man.
sentences.cn: 他是一个害羞、有时不快乐的人。

synos.cn: 不快乐的；不幸福的；不适当的

trans.cn: 联合，统一；联合的行为、实例或过程

sentences.c: With unification, East Germany was subsumed by capitalist West Germany.
sentences.cn: 统一后，东德被归入资本主义的西德。

sentences.c: The controversy has arisen over the text of the preamble to the unification treaty.
sentences.cn: 就统一条约的序文措词出现了争论。

sentences.c: Germany has made great progress at finding its place in the world since unification, but it is not yet over the hump of history.
sentences.cn: 自两德统一以来，德国在寻找自己在世界上的位置方面取得了巨大的进步，但它还没有走出历史的低谷。

trans.cn: nhất quán

sentences.c: We sell wholesale to several chains that sell retail to the public.
sentences.cn: 我们批发给几家向公众零售的连锁店。

sentences.c: They are only doing what is necessary to prevent wholesale destruction of vegetation.
sentences.cn: 他们只是在做为防止植被遭大规模破坏而必须做的事情。

trans.cn: 未开发的地区，荒野；荒芜的地方，杂草丛生处；低潮时期，在野；大量，茫茫一片

sentences.c: This area has been christened 'Britain's last wilderness'.
sentences.cn: 这个地区被命名为“英国最后的荒野”。

sentences.c: The Wilderness Society lobbied Congress to authorize the Endangered Species Act.
sentences.cn: 荒野协会游说国会批准《濒危物种法》。

sentences.c: Wilderness designation prohibits road building, the use of mechanized equipment and most other developments.
sentences.cn: 荒野之地禁止筑路、使用机械设备以及绝大多数其它的开发。

phrases.cn: 在野的；荒原；离开政界的

trans.cn: 意外之财；被风吹落的果子；意外的收获

sentences.c: The water treatment was new, now, and Tom's low condition was a windfall to her.
sentences.cn: 现在新出了水疗法，而正好汤姆状态低迷，这下她可来了劲儿。

sentences.c: An oil boom would also mean a multibillion-dollar windfall in tax revenues, royalties and leasing fees for Alaska and the Federal Government.
sentences.cn: 石油产业的繁荣还意味着阿拉斯加和联邦政府将获得数十亿美元的意外之财：税收收入、特许权使用费和租赁费。

sentences.c: The winner scored 10 pts.
sentences.cn: 获胜者得了10分。

sentences.c: The winner was timed at 20.4 seconds.
sentences.cn: 获胜者用的时间为20.4秒。

sentences.c: The winner gets first pick of the prizes.
sentences.cn: 获胜者可先挑奖品。

trans.cn: 冗长的；口头的；唠叨的；文字的

sentences.c: The chapter is mostly wordy rhetoric.
sentences.cn: 这一章多半是冗长的华丽词藻。

sentences.c: Awkward or wordy phrasing or unclear sentences and paragraphs should be mercilessly poked and prodded into shape.
sentences.cn: 要毫不保留地挑出那些糟糕的、冗长的用词，表意不明的句子或段落，仔细润色。

sentences.c: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive.
sentences.cn: 未来的政府需要做更多工作，为体育的繁荣提供条件，而不是提供有价值但冗长的战略。

synos.cn: 冗长的；口头的；唠叨的；文字的

trans.cn_source: （国家或地区的）劳动力，劳动人口；（某组织或公司的）全体员工，全体从业人员

sentences.c: The total was close to 20% of the workforce.
sentences.cn: 总数接近劳动力的20%。

sentences.c: The company yesterday shed a sixth of its workforce.
sentences.cn: 该公司昨天削减了1/6的劳动力。

sentences.c: The decision incensed the workforce.
sentences.cn: 这个决定激怒了劳工大众。

synos.cn: 劳动力；工人总数，职工总数

trans.cn: khối lượng công việc (của một người hoặc tổ chức)
trans.cn_source: （人或组织的）工作量，工作负荷

sentences.c: They could not stand the pace or the workload.
sentences.cn: 他们受不了工作的节奏和负荷。

sentences.c: He cited his heavy workload as the reason for his breakdown.
sentences.cn: 他说繁重的工作负荷是导致他累垮的原因。

sentences.c: You need someone to bounce ideas off and share your workload.
sentences.cn: 你需要有人和你探讨想法并分担你的工作量。

trans.cn: （办公室，工厂）等工作场所；（办公室，工厂）等工作场所

sentences.c: The problem of ageism in the workplace often goes unrecognized.
sentences.cn: 工作场所的年龄歧视问题常被忽视。

sentences.c: The government will legislate against discrimination in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 政府将制定法律，在工作场所禁止歧视。

sentences.c: He tried to open an account at the branch of his bank nearest to his workplace.
sentences.cn: 他试图在离他工作地点最近的银行分行开立账户。

trans.cn: 工作站

sentences.c: Make sure your workstation is correct.
sentences.cn: 确保你的工作站是正确的。

sentences.c: Above each machinist's workstation, there was a wooden cube with a different colour painted on each face.
sentences.cn: 在每个机械师的工作站上方，都有一个木制的立方体，每个面都涂着不同的颜色。

sentences.c: Each employee was given a biscuit and a cup of tea, guided to a workstation and within half an hour started a 12-hour shift fitting glass screens into beveled frames.
sentences.cn: 每位员工都得到了一块饼干和一杯茶，然后被带到一个工作站，半小时内开始了12个小时的轮班工作，将玻璃屏幕安装成斜面框架。

trans.cn: 令人担心的，使人发愁的，让人焦虑的

sentences.c: Canadian scientists have found a worrisome, new example of the power that birds have to spread stuff around.
sentences.cn: 加拿大科学家发现了一个令人担忧的新例子，证明鸟类具有四处传播东西的力量。

sentences.c: Despite the success of the experiment, the actual results are worrisome, and mostly confirm earlier studies.
sentences.cn: 尽管实验取得了成功，但实际结果却令人担忧，基本上证实了早些时候的研究。

sentences.c: They reason that since top executives evidently have faith in the bank's financial soundness, those worrisome rumors must be false.
sentences.cn: 他们认为，由于高管们显然对该行的财务稳健抱有信心，那些令人担忧的传言肯定是假的。

synos.cn: 令人烦恼的，令人不安的；麻烦的

háo hức
trans.cn_source: 渴望的

trans.cn: 怀念，渴望（yearn 的现在分词）

sentences.c: He always had a yearning to be a schoolteacher.
sentences.cn: 他一直渴望当一名教师。

sentences.c: If the arms are outstretched in the yearning position, the person tends to be more suspicious.
sentences.cn: 如果双臂伸出，呈渴望状，这种人往往比较多疑。

sentences.c: She had no great yearning to go back.
sentences.cn: 她并不十分想回去。
